name: tradingview-stock-screener-scraper
title: TradingView Stock Screener Scraper (No Login)
description: Screen stocks, crypto, and forex from TradingView's scanner. Filter by market cap, price, volume, sector, P/E, dividend yield, RSI, and daily change. One row per symbol with price, change, volume, market cap, P/E, dividend yield, RSI, sector, industry, exchange, country, YTD. No login. Pay per row.
